headline: Big Bank Stocks on Thursday (24/9) All in the Red, Foreigners Still Dumping Bank Shares
summary: Big bank stocks, including BMRI, BBRI, BBNI and BBCA, were again under pressure from foreign net selling on Thursday, 24 September. The BI Rate of 5.75% was viewed as a positive sentiment for these shares.
why: Large Indonesian banks such as Bank Mandiri, BRI, BNI and BCA are heavily weighted in the Jakarta Composite Index and are widely held by foreign investors. Their share moves influence the wider Indonesian market.
why_moved: Foreign investors continued net selling of bank shares, while the BI Rate of 5.75% was seen as a supportive factor that did not offset the outflows.
